title: A Wandering Dog
subtitle: Ears low, tail down, she sidles back to the shadow of the house.

trails.title: Trail ① A Troublesome Neighbor
trails.description: They are noisy, aggressive and many.

items.text: A Wandering Dog

items.speaker: Committee Member Ⅰ
items.text: We are on page 21, section 3.

items.speaker: Committee Member Ⅰ
items.text: Ms. Z insists on adopting this draft.

items.speaker: Committee Member Ⅰ
items.text: Ms. Z, please walk Madam Constantine through this section.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: No need for that. I have read the stenographer's report.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: In fact, this is the second time I'm addressing this proposal. Considering the Integratus has been very determined to its submission, I believe many delegates must have a burning interest in the case.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: At least it's worth some discussions.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Pedra, why do you oppose it?

items.speaker: Committee Member Ⅰ
items.text: The rise of Manus Vindictae has caused the arcanum world to gradually break free from the Foundation.

items.speaker: Committee Member Ⅰ
items.text: Therefore we need to monitor what our arcanists think and control what they do in a stricter manner, in case they go too far.

items.speaker: Committee Member Ⅰ
items.text: Manus Vindictae has a subversive slogan. Their influence has been getting bigger since the first "Storm," so has the scale of their infiltration.

items.speaker: Committee Member Ⅰ
items.text: In The Walden incident in 1929, we were given away in advance. It probably had something to do with the infiltration.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Very well, a point worth discussion.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: But it is not relevant to our subject here and now.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Stenographer, please take down the point Mr. Rosa just made. That will be the subject of our meeting in the third week.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Katz, what do you think?

items.speaker: Committee Member Ⅱ
items.text: The expectations of our constituencies are on our shoulders.

items.speaker: Committee Member Ⅱ
items.text: Fear of the arcanists has grown due to the attacks by Manus Vindictae in many regions.

items.speaker: Committee Member Ⅱ
items.text: It's not ideal for us to implement the "Peace Policy" and promote the arcane technology.

items.speaker: Committee Member Ⅱ
items.text: To maintain the Foundation's reputation, we have to start with the registered arcanists. Strengthen the regulations, and show the public that arcanists are reasonable and trustworthy.

items.speaker: Committee Member Ⅱ
items.text: That is why I am opposed to the draft.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: ... Inspiring.
She stands up, pacing around in the meeting room.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: However, what a shame, none of you have realized the key factor in this subject.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: What is the key element that decides whether this proposal will be approved or not?

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Manus Vindictae?

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: The constituents?

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: No. It's far simpler than those.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: It's Vertin.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: According to the proposal, Vertin will become the only tie between these unregistered arcanists and the Foundation.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: As the number of Vertin's field missions increases, she will inevitably get in touch with more and more unregistered arcanists.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: That is to say, outside the Foundation's jurisdiction, a group of people is getting stronger each day—an armed force.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Her attitude towards the Foundation will be the key to all the issues.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Vertin received her education in SPDM from an early age. She has a clear tendency.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Yes, that's what I think.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: That's also why I have asked someone who can provide a valid argument on the issue to join us.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: You may come in, Sonetto.
The door is pushed ajar.
Sonetto enters the room, humbly and prudently. Her uniform seems to have changed a little.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: ... Good day, Madam Vice President. Greetings to all committee members. May the peace be with us.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: The Timekeeper is still in treatment. Before she is restored to health, I appoint you to take care of all the relevant matters on her behalf.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Copy that.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Now, I will ask you some questions. Please answer them truthfully.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Clear.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Based on your observation, do you or do you not think the Timekeeper has been loyal to the Foundation?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Of, of course!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: All the students of the School of Primary Defense of Mankind are devoted to the peace of mankind. We have pledged lifelong allegiance to the Foundation that leads the cause.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Heh heh, that's not what I'm asking.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Let's put it differently. Why do you think Vertin would provoke other students to rebel when she was in school?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I ... I do not know ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I am sorry.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: After the incident of the "Storm," why would Vertin show reluctance to invite the unregistered arcanists to join the Foundation?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Because ... Emm ...

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: At one point in her negotiation with the Manus Vindictae, Vertin has agreed to join them. What do you think her true intention was?

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: That'll be enough. I believe we all have our answers by now.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Madam Vice President! A-According to our investigation of the event in 1929 and Timekeeper's report, it is highly possible that Arcana of Manus Vindictae has the arcane power to influence the sanity and consciousness of others from a certain distance.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: She is able to exert an irresistible psychic influence on others through short conversations. Timekeeper ... Timekeeper was under huge threats at that time.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I think all of her responses were out of her survival instinct.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: This is also one of the survival strategies that have been taught in Chapter 1, Book 3 of Introduction to Strategy edited by the School of Primary Defense of Mankind.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: I see. You may leave the room now.
Sonetto's eyes turn red.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: We appreciate the information you just added. You have always been an excellent student. We are very proud of you.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Now it's time to leave and rest.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: ... Copy that.
She leaves the room as instructed.
Silence fills the room.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: What a controversial issue.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: What's your view on this, Ms. Z?
Madam Z stands up. She takes her time before speaking.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: In my point of view ... Vertin does have doubts about current system.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: But doubts don't mean disloyalty.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: In fact, if we want to further expand the staff to contend against the Manus Vindictae...

items.speaker: Z
items.text: We need flexible management.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Apply customized standards to arcanists with different backgrounds and different training objectives.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Through this, not only can we remove the doubts of Vertin, but also ease the tension between the Foundation and other unregistered arcanists.
Constantine squints at her.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: You have been very thoughtful.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Carry it out then.
The stenographer pauses out of surprise.
She looks up at Constantine, seeking confirmation from the look on her face.
The stenographer quickly regains her composure and starts typing.
"Pass"
TO BE CONTINUED…
